card.name: Reign or tenure after a ruler's name
card.fires_on: The word reign, or tenure, right after a ruler's name or his/monarch's, in history text about kings, popes or officeholders.

modes.label: Reign of a monarch
modes.description: The word reign after a king's name or a possessive like his or monarch's.
modes.example: Charlemagne led his empire through countless amount of wars during his<< reign>>.

modes.label: Tenure in office
modes.description: The word tenure after an official's name or his, describing time in office.
modes.example: During Hoover’s<< tenure>> as FBI director (1924
